cases.name: Janet Ipsaro Adams
cases.about: She was a newlywed of a few days.
cases.narrative: On 4/4/1966, she was found nude in her second story garage apartment on the bathroom floor. She had been strangled with her husband’s neck tie (or hairnet) in the bedroom. Her bra was torn. She had been been dragged into bathroom, and was found in the bathtub half-filled with water. She had a bruised forehead and scratches on her hands, and a 4-inch pair of scissors had been driven into in her left breast post-mortem. Signs of recent sexual activity, but no indications of forcible rape.
